class.name: IfcAppliedValueRelationship
class.brief_description: An IfcAppliedValueRelationship is a relationship class that enables cost values to be aggregated together as components of another cost value. HISTORY New Entity in Release IFC2.0. IFC2x4 CHANGE Subtyped from IfcResourceLevelRelationship , attribute order changed. members.member: The applied value (total or subtotal) of which the value being considered is a component. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.
Applied values that are components of another applied value and from which that applied value may be deduced. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.
